title: Model Laboratory for LLM Comparison
summary: This module provides a utility class, `ModelLaboratory`, designed to experiment with and compare the performance of different language models or predefined chains. It allows users to input text and observe the varied outputs from multiple models, facilitating evaluation and selection.

nodes.label: Model Laboratory
nodes.title: Manages LLM/Chain Comparisons
nodes.description: A utility class designed to facilitate experimentation and performance comparison across various language models or predefined chains. It allows users to input text and observe how different models respond, aiding in model selection and evaluation.

nodes.label: User Input Text
nodes.title: Input for Model Comparison
nodes.description: The textual data provided by the user to be processed and compared by the different models or chains within the ModelLaboratory.

nodes.label: Base Language Model
nodes.title: Generative AI Model
nodes.description: A foundational large language model that generates text based on given prompts. ModelLaboratory can create comparison chains directly from a list of these models.

nodes.label: Prompt Template
nodes.title: Structured Input for LLMs
nodes.description: A reusable blueprint for generating prompts to LLMs, defining the structure and variables for input. Used by ModelLaboratory when constructing chains from raw LLMs.

nodes.label: Executable LLM Chain
nodes.title: Sequence of LLM Operations
nodes.description: A sequence of modular components that process input and generate output, often involving an LLM, prompt, and output parser. ModelLaboratory uses these to perform comparisons.

nodes.label: Comparison Results Display
nodes.title: Visualized Model Outputs
nodes.description: The aggregated and formatted outputs from each model or chain, displayed to the user for direct comparison and analysis.
